title: Domain Model element
description: The frontmatter of one element file, domain/<context-slug>/<element-slug>.md (SPEC-002). The filename is the identity: no name field exists, and the display form is derived from the slug — `display` is declared only where the derivation would miscase an acronym, and it must reduce back to the slug. No provenance meta-fields exist (SPEC-001 R8): a fact the material does not state is decided and disclosed in the decision log. The body carries exactly two headings, `## Description` and `## Responsibility`.

type.description: The DDD construct this element records. Which fields it may declare follows from it (SPEC-002 R6).

display.description: The display form, only where PascalCase(slug) would miscase an acronym. Must reduce back to the slug.

aggregate.description: Entity only: the aggregate root that owns this entity, by slug, in the same context. A value object never declares one — values are shareable and belong to no consistency boundary.

operations.description: Domain behavior by name only — kebab-case verbs. Parameters, returns and refusals live in the behavioral layers.

values.description: Enumeration only. kebab-case; code forms are derived.

attributeName.description: snake_case; the camelCase code form is derived.

attributeType.description: A primitive (string, integer, decimal, boolean, date, datetime) or the slug of a value-object or enumeration element — bare inside the same context, full identity across contexts (SPEC-003 R2). A link to an entity or aggregate root is a relationship, never an attribute (SPEC-002 R8). `unknown` does not exist: an undetermined type is a decision to make and log.

many.description: The attribute's value repeats (SPEC-002 R9). Absent means one value.

target.description: An entity or aggregate root — bare slug inside the same context, full identity across.

type.description: composition never crosses an aggregate boundary; reference points at another aggregate's root, by identity (SPEC-002 R11).

cardinality.description: The target end. The source end is 1 for composition and 0..* otherwise, unless source-cardinality overrides (SPEC-002 R10).

role.description: Labels the edge; required when two relationships share the same target.
